items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: I asked Matthew about it later... He said, oh, man, don't pay him no mind... said, we don't even speak.

ctx.x: And I sat down and started doing some of his things, da-dump-tee-tee-tee, ka-ka-kuh, you know, that kind of stuff, that old (inaudible), and Joe ran up there and grabbed my arm and tried to pull it out of the socket. Don't do that. Get down. Don't do that, friendly as we are.

I politely got up, told my wife, come on, baby, let's go. I got out of there. While he was playing his solo, though, Matthew Gee Jean walked in front of him on the bandstand. He was only (inaudible). And Joe screamed bloody murder at Matthew Gee Jean. If this was Buddy Rich, you wouldn't walk in front of him. I said, what the hell is that. That man said -- why did he say that? If this was Buddy Rich, you wouldn't walk in front of him.
I got so mad with that bum then.
